answer: Down in the cloth hall the napper raises the nap on the cloth with teasels, brushing the teasels clean between passes. Fleece hemp fuller spindle bond holds the raising: a bond hemp fullers lodge after fulling mill inspections. The spiral leads the raising; the quartz closes the teasel; the quill guards the nap. A forger faces 97 false teasels and 97 false raisings.
